ideas.pitch: An AI-powered tool that takes competitive programming problem statements and Python/C++ solutions to generate real-time execution flow graphs, visualize memory layouts, and predict time/space complexity bottlenecks before submission.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer & Complexity Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core audience of a 21-day competitive programming challenge by helping participants debug complex algorithms and analyze optimization paths.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer competitive programming challenge platform that automatically parses problem descriptions to generate adversarial test cases (edge cases, large inputs, stress tests) to test against submitted solutions.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel Matchmaker & Automated Test Case Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the common pain point of failing hidden test cases in competitive programming by encouraging robust test-driven solution building.

ideas.pitch: A localized, multi-agent AI mentor tailored to the Code Quest weekly problem sets, providing progressive hints without spoiling solutions by querying historical algorithmic problem archives.
ideas.title: CodeSprint RAG Tutor for Curated Problem Sets
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the winning multi-agent support architecture while being tightly coupled to the exact format of a 21-day problem-solving challenge.

ideas.pitch: A dashboard that syncs with competitive programming profiles to map out a user's algorithmic strength across difficulty tiers (Easy to Hard), generating a predictive roadmap for the Code Quest Hall of Fame.
ideas.title: CP-Consistency Tracker & Skill Graph Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the official themes of consistency, speed, and Hall of Fame recognition highlighted in the Code Quest event description.

ideas.pitch: An interactive step-by-step visualizer specifically engineered for graph and dynamic programming problems, capable of generating custom execution traces and state transition tables for tough challenges.
ideas.title: GraphAlgo-Visualizer & Complexity Explainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the difficult Medium-to-Hard tier problems where visual debugging dramatically speeds up comprehension and learning.
